name: Fill-Height Inference via PoCA
definition: A regression method to predict furnace fill-height by computing a weighted average of the z-positions of Points of Closest Approach (PoCAs), leveraging the monotonic relationship between mean PoCA z-position and fill-height.
summary: Fill-Height Inference via PoCA predicts furnace fill-level by computing a weighted average of muon trajectory z-positions, using transverse weighting to mitigate wall bias and avoiding computationally expensive voxel-based density reconstruction.
